items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: While I was working at the Capitol, Gee was in town, you know

ctx.x: Oh, no, you put a lot of things in there. You use rum, scotch, bourbon... It's just a conglomerate drink. That's why they call it a Zombie, you know. In fact, that was my lunch! Heh-heh. To keep from being hungry.

While I was working at the Capitol, Gee was in town, you know, and Shorty Sherock used to come around. And he used to try to make me drunk, you know. He would set up like ten drinks on the bar. I would drink all ten of them. He'd say, "Ten more," you know. But don't forget, there wasn't too much in them drinks either. In them clubs, you know, they don't put too much in the glass, especially if you're drinking by the shot. I was drinking supposedly
